title: Homology-level lift from a constant adic quotient realization
statement: Under the same hypotheses as the constant quotient realization reflection statement, a realized isomorphism admits an algebraic morphism whose maps on every cohomology object are isomorphisms.

source.place: Tags 093J and 03Q3, the nonempty-chart stalk detection part

proof.text: Transport the realized isomorphism through the canonical quotient comparison and inverse-image constant-section comparison. Apply the exact geometric stalk at the supplied point; constant-section detection identifies the stalked cohomology maps with algebraic cohomology maps, all of which are invertible. Naturality through the localization gives one algebraic morphism with invertible maps on every cohomology object.

proof_origin.place: Tags 093J and 03Q3, the nonempty-chart stalk detection part

theorem constantAdicQuotientRealization_homology_lift
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (n : ℕ)
    (W : Y.Etale) (_w : W.left)
    (E F : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (AdicCompletion d.ideal A ⧸
      (d.ideal.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A))) ^ (n + 1))))
    (h : Nonempty ((constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d n).obj E ≅
      (constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d n).obj F)) :
    ∃ f : E ⟶ F, ∀ i : ℤ,
      IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (AdicCompletion d.ideal A ⧸
          (d.ideal.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A))) ^ (n + 1))) i).map f)
